# Global Sources

> Global Sources is a B2B marketplace and trade show platform connecting international buyers with suppliers across multiple industries and regions worldwide.

Global Sources operates major trade exhibitions and sourcing events in key markets including Hong Kong, China, Vietnam, Indonesia, and the Middle East. The platform provides supplier discovery, buyer services, and sourcing intelligence to facilitate global import-export trade.

## Key Topics

- Trade Shows & Exhibitions
- B2B Marketplace
- Supplier Discovery
- Global Sourcing
- Hong Kong Shows
- China Sourcing
- Buyer Services
- Import-Export
- VIP Buyer Programs
- Sourcing Intelligence
- Global Events
- Regional Expos

## Trade Shows & Exhibitions

- [Global Sources Exhibitions, Activities & Events: Bridging Markets Worldwide](https://exhibitions.globalsources.com/): Global Sources exhibitions and trade shows connecting buyers and suppliers worldwide across multiple regions and industries
